title: Meeting up with Armstrong on the road in the 1930s
summary: Alcorn says bands constantly ran into each other on tour across the country in the 1930s.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: When did you next see him after that time in 1930 in New Orleans? When was the next time that...
Yeah, after that time you saw him that night.

Well, I left waiting here without I was band. We had a travel band. We used to run into each other over. San Antonio, we would meet in different places. We met in Miami. Wherever they'd be playing, different places we'd always run into.
This was all during the 30s? Yeah, all bands was running over each other in the 30s. Yeah.
We had everybody out on the board. We was running over each other. All bands out there.
